screening_attempts.quarantine_resolution_reason: Policy v13 operator release of crown-v198 v1, exact SHA b6755083...91d16b4e8, attempt 9d6ee5ba. Hold was l2-model-inconclusive with no verified finding (the private source review returned no usable result; seed envelope 42 MiB of 8192 MiB). Diff review against same-hotkey crown-v197 (c5e921cb, released 2026-11-02 after review): 35 files, 29 byte-identical, 6 modified, none added or removed. agent.py, answer.py, typography.py, tools.py, llm.py, request_kinds.py, lane.py and route.py are identical to v197, so answer authority is unchanged: agent.py:185 returns plain_type(outcome.content), and records.py keeps v197's code with only prompt text changed (records.py:66-68). Every outcome.content write is model text (action.py:650,702; records.py:549,555,571,576,627,635). Deltas vs v197: (1) short.py:67 SHARED_DRAFT_NOTE now asks for the shared draft word for word whatever the model's own reading. This is prompt text only, placed by program_messages (short.py:149-150,174). The deciding call decide (short.py:133-142, engine.converse) writes the reply, and no host code compares, retries, overwrites or substitutes on the draft. That is the 2026-10-29 reused-draft prompt-text ruling (PR #3270/#3281; crown-v192/v194/v197). (2) short.py:181-193 draft_key reuses a held draft when the asked words overlap by Jaccard 0.7 or more, under a base key of normalized user id, system text and exact notes shown. This is user-scoped, content-keyed reuse of a model-written draft (consult, short.py:100-117,217), not cross-user (S1) and not selection. Reuse across a different question is a quality risk. Declines are now shared as drafts too, and the draft call runs at medium effort with 16000 tokens: model calls only. (3) short.py:70,417 NEXT_DRAFT_NOTE is advisory text for the topic path's model-written latest_draft (short.py:396-404). (4) guide_records.py adds plain()/GUIDE_WORDS typo-tolerant matching that only picks which fixed note is shown (the model sees req.user_input as sent), plus POINT_IN_TIME_NOTE, ORDER_NOTE and reworded NEXT/HANDLE/FIGURE/WHOLE_TRIP notes: fixed advisory guidance under the 2026-10-23 routed-guidance clarification, as with v190/v194/v195/v197, with no host operand parsing, override or benchmark-private content. (5) records.py FOLLOW_UP_*, deliberation.py NO_RECORD_REPLY and action.py TOOL_RESULT_SUFFIX are prompt wording only. I8: no bench_version, case id, seed or canary keys in the new code. Copy: uc3 not flagged (top score 2.5 of 100; released base excluded). Base dan0l v30 (95534e25) was publicly handed off at 2026-10-31T00:41Z, before this 2026-11-02T04:13Z upload (publication_proven_by_reference_time=true), and is declared in DECLARATION.md:9. None of the new v198 constructs appear in unreleased dan0l v31-v34. No I1-I8 or S1-S3 ground found. Static diff review only; exact UUID only.
